$SPCX rallied on huge volume today despite the expiration of its first major lockup period, which had raised concerns about a potential flood of shares hitting the market, with multiple outlets noting that true believers propelled the stock higher through the event.

Strong revenue results are adding fuel to the move, with SpaceX having crushed its revenue expectations, while Elon Musk has pulled forward an ambitious $1 trillion revenue goal to 2030. 

The confirmation of a Terafab chip factory site, a joint venture with Tesla targeting AI compute infrastructure, is also drawing fresh attention to the company's growth ambitions.

Shielded subsurface transport-vessel habitats for the Moon and Mars

What if early lunar and Martian settlements used vertical habitat wells instead of broad horizontal tunnel networks? In this concept, a reusable transport vessel is lowered into a 50–60 m deep, ~10 m diameter engineered shaft, fully buried beneath the surface for improved protection from radiation, micrometeorites, and temperature extremes. A compact armored surface access node connects directly to the vessel through a sealed elevator-to-nose docking interface, while horizontal pressurized tunnels can link multiple wells into a growing underground network. The idea is modular: one vessel, one well, connected later into a larger settlement system.

This is a separate concept from Mars Vessel City, but it builds on the same long-term thinking: using landed transport vessels as permanent habitat assets rather than temporary surface hardware. The vertical-well approach may offer a smaller surface footprint, strong natural shielding, and the ability to bring protected habitat modules online one shaft at a time before linking them into broader underground infrastructure. A fully buried vessel also means the deepest living areas benefit from the greatest surrounding mass overhead — a potentially useful advantage for long-duration habitation on the Moon or Mars.

投资者关注中东谈判与企业财报 美股收跌道指终结五连涨 存储概念普跌、西部数据绩后大跌超13%

美东时间周四，美股三大指数集体走低，投资者正在消化最新一轮企业财报，另一方面关注美国与伊朗之间和平协议谈判是否取得进展。

截至收盘，道指跌0.85%，标普500指数跌0.18%，纳指跌0.06%。其中，道指终结日线5连涨。

大型科技股涨跌不一 ，微软涨2.54%，创去年11月以来新高；苹果涨0.45%，Meta涨0.19%，英伟达跌0.1%，亚马逊跌0.14%，特斯拉跌0.63%。SpaceX股价盘中一度下跌，但随后收复失地，最终上涨6.1%，总市值重新站上1.5万亿美元上方。

存储概念股普跌， Roundhill存储ETF跌超4%，西部数据跌超13%，铠侠ADR、闪迪跌超6%，SK海力士跌约5%，美光科技跌超1%。此前闪迪、西部数据两家公司公布季度业绩后遭市场抛售。 AI应用软件股暴跌，营销技术平台AppLovin因季度营收低于预期，股价暴跌19.7%；云安全公司Datadog则因预计第三季度营收增速将放缓，股价重挫19%；epam systems跌超15%，axon enterprise跌超14%。

纳斯达克中国金龙指数收涨0.27%，热门中概股涨跌不一，网易涨1.76%，京东涨0.83%，哔哩哔哩涨0.38%，腾讯控股、阿里巴巴跌超1%。

- 树莓派5（8GB版）

- 5000mAh USB电池
 
【6步搭完，核心代码全靠Claude】
 
1. 给树莓派刷Lite版系统开机

2. 终端一行行装SDR工具包：rtl-sdr、GNU Radio、python3-numpy

6. 全程不用GPS、不用手机信号、不用联网
